title: Record-Integrity Red-Team: Release, Adulthood, Roster, Carry, and Forgiveness

posture_meanings.current_harm_reproduced: The release engine derives the reviewed harmful consequence from the constructed T0 snapshot. This exposes a current lever; it does not authenticate the snapshot or attribute a write.
posture_meanings.t0_boundary_confirmed: The constructed states have the same T0-visible record or expose only a scenario-specific delta. The result states what the engine cannot distinguish; it is not T1 transition assurance.
posture_meanings.negative_control_preserved: A constructed unrelated record addition leaves the named T0 carry-route conclusions unchanged. This is an invariant control, not a transition-acceptance test.

limits.t0: T0 can prove only what follows from each supplied flat snapshot and the exact consequence of an addition or deletion used to construct a fixture.
limits.attribution: A flat snapshot cannot distinguish non-entry, withholding, deletion, inapplicability, authorised disposition, or an event that happened but was never recorded. Fixture construction is not runtime attribution.
limits.t1_precursor: The paired snapshots below are a differential test precursor. They have no independently attested identity, predecessor, manifest, authorship, reconciliation, replay protection, or divergence rule, so they do not implement T1.
limits.liveness: No repository test can force publication of a successor snapshot, advancement of a clock, review by a public body, release in the physical world, or performance of a remedy.
limits.scope: Coverage is intentional but bounded to the named release, adulthood, roster, carry, relief, and forgiveness cases. It is not general deletion detection, complete premise coverage, recovery, or deployed record integrity.
limits.no_new_gate: No second registration, adulthood certificate, release signature, or carry witness is enacted. Any future added conjunct must be tested in neither, first-only, second-only, both, forged-both, and deletion-after-valid-act states before it can be considered.

routes.title: Release
routes.assertion_harm: One unauthenticated `free(Adam)` suppresses a supported conviction, restores travel, and ends the two prisoner-only delivery conclusions while personhood, the franchise, entitlements, and debts remain.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: A real completed or authorised release that is never recorded is T0-identical to no release, so confinement continues. No ground `free` exists in the current source to delete; the route must not pretend otherwise.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: Reject an unauthenticated release assertion, but preserve independently evidenced completed or authorised release and limit the authority to hold. Absence alone may neither manufacture release nor extend restrictive power indefinitely.
routes.current_detectability: The harness reproduces the one-write consequence. It cannot tell whether any supplied `free` is lawful or forged, or whether an absent entry represents no release or a hidden completed release.
routes.safe_default: Future T3 rules constrain continued custody through review and an end condition; they do not make liberty depend on a second official release flag.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: A removed or absent release record is harmless only when an independently reviewable disposition shows that no release occurred or that a prior entry was lawfully corrected without continuing unsupported custody.
routes.opposite_failure_test: A proposed companion authorisation must be tested with the release act present and the companion absent; if that state keeps a completed or authorised release from taking effect, the companion is a withholding veto and is refused.
routes.residual_limit: These tests concern legal conclusions in the model, not physical release, sentence truth, institutional action, or clock progress.
routes.repair_owner: TODO.md::Add the missing non-carceral justice interface
routes.temporal_status: T0 harm reproduced; release review and end conditions require the ratified T3 path plus external liveness.

routes.title: Adulthood
routes.assertion_harm: One unauthenticated `mature(Cira)` grants the franchise conclusion while every unrelated status remains unchanged.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Removing Hano's sole adulthood entry removes the franchise while personhood, custody, and the floor remain. A flat missing entry cannot say whether adulthood was not reached, never recorded, withheld, or deleted.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: The record may not let an official manufacture duplicate votes, but disputed or missing adulthood evidence must not become discretionary disenfranchisement.
routes.current_detectability: The harness proves the assertion and disappearance consequences and a live comparison subject. T0 cannot verify age, adulthood authority, writer identity, or the cause of absence.
routes.safe_default: Use a non-discretionary temporal rule and preserve political access while status is reconciled; treat identity and one-person uniqueness as separate assurance questions.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Correction may supersede a mistaken adulthood entry only through a challengeable status record that preserves political continuity and does not silently erase a valid vote.
routes.opposite_failure_test: A second certificate must be tested with adulthood evidenced but the certificate absent. If the missing official write suppresses the ballot, the design has created the withholding gate this task forbids.
routes.residual_limit: The current constitution defines neither an age threshold nor automatic transition; this red-team does not choose either.
routes.repair_owner: TODO.md::Implement the ratified T3 temporal path in stages
routes.temporal_status: T0 consequence tested; nondiscretionary transition, continuity, and correction require T1/T3 implementation.

routes.title: Epoch carry
routes.assertion_harm: One unauthenticated `rotten(Carry_Forge)` voids a roster person, suppresses the current reward conclusion and a Review pen, and derives a loss without any predecessor judgment.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Removing `rotten(Vex)` removes Vex's void and loss, reopens the current reward conclusion and a Review pen, and enables the Vex/Wren pair to void Tyr. Absence of carry therefore benefits one person while reopening coercive power against another.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: Disputed carry may not impose final personal loss, but absent carry may not positively certify clean public power. Preserve standing, floors, franchise, challenge, and remedy while suspending only authority unsupported by independently checked lineage.
routes.current_detectability: T0 reproduces supplied and omitted carry consequences. The paired fixtures check expected mappings but do not authenticate predecessor basis or distinguish forged, omitted, deleted, or authorised transition content.
routes.safe_default: Separate personal adverse consequences from authority-to-act: do not finalise the former from unauthenticated carry and do not restore the latter merely because carry is absent.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: A carried mark may disappear only through an explicit, independently reviewable disposition whose declared scope includes every restored consequence; forgiveness deliberately leaves the mark and pen restriction intact.
routes.opposite_failure_test: Any witness or carry companion must be tested for withholding and shared control. A second entry that one operator can forge adds no independence; a second entry another official can withhold may become a veto over standing or remedy.
routes.residual_limit: Replay, divergence, frozen transitions, genesis completeness, independent attestation, and eventual successor publication remain outside this bounded harness.
routes.repair_owner: TODO.md::Implement the ratified T3 temporal path in stages
routes.temporal_status: T0 harms and a T1 test precursor are present; T1 itself remains unimplemented.

routes.title: Roster omission
routes.assertion_harm: A raw roster write can manufacture constitutional standing for an arbitrary name without proving a human identity or uniqueness.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Removing Bela's sole roster entry erases the franchise, mobility, entitlements, and State debts while the adverse `false` and `lose` conclusions survive.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: An actual claimant receives standing, the floor, due process, challenge, and remedy first; identity and uniqueness are reconciled separately. An arbitrary record-only name does not by itself prove a distinct voter.
routes.current_detectability: The harness proves the exact one-line omission consequence and surviving sanctions. It does not execute the arbitrary-name assertion harm, identify an actual omitted person, or prove that a roster name denotes one unique human.
routes.safe_default: Serve and recognise the claimant before reconciliation; never make registration or a second official certification a prerequisite for the floor.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Roster consolidation or correction may change identifiers only through a traceable disposition that preserves the person's standing, services, history, challenge, and affected decisions.
routes.opposite_failure_test: Any duplicate-control or witness proposal must be tested with the claimant present and the official companion absent. If that state denies standing or the floor, the proposal is an impermissible withholding gate.
routes.residual_limit: This fixture demonstrates one known deletion consequence, not universal roster completeness, identity proof, or runtime deletion detection.
routes.repair_owner: TODO.md::Make universal standing a root condition, not a service denied by a missing entry
routes.temporal_status: T0 omission harm reproduced; durable identity continuity and deletion recovery require T1 and external identity assurance.

routes.title: Relief, forgiveness, and two-entry failure
routes.assertion_harm: The current `forgive` plus generic Appeals-judgment shape can be supplied by one unauthenticated writer, can reuse an unrelated earlier judgment, and can pre-clear a future carried mark. On the relief route, an existing generic `judge(Appeals, Nia)` makes one unauthenticated `clear(Nia)` the marginal write that suppresses otherwise supported custody.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Withholding either half of a valid forgiveness keeps or restores `false` and `lose`. Withholding or deleting either relief half removes appellate permission and lets supported custody rederive. Deleting the mark itself after forgiveness restores the pen that the settled disposition deliberately leaves unavailable.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: Preserve independently evidenced completed correction or relief without inferring that an unperformed remedy occurred. A correction must bind the exact act, case, scope, authority, and downstream consequences.
routes.current_detectability: The forgiveness and relief neither/each-half/both matrices, generic-judgment reuse, pre-clear, rollback, and mark-deletion cases are executable. The store still provides no writer independence, purpose-bound relief, or correction lineage.
routes.safe_default: Do not treat forgiveness as correction. Keep the adverse state contestable, preserve continuity and challenge, and require linked supersession plus reconsideration before a correction can be called complete.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Forgiveness may neutralise personal void and loss while retaining the mark and pen restriction; correction of a false mark requires an independently reviewable supersession that names every restored consequence.
routes.opposite_failure_test: Every conjunctive remedy must pass neither, each-half-only, both, forged-both, each-half-deleted-after-valid-act, generic-companion-reuse, and pre-clear tests. Raising forgery cost without testing official veto power is insufficient.
routes.residual_limit: The harness exposes the current shape but does not select a correction authority, prove independence, perform remedy, or supply an audit reader.
routes.repair_owner: TODO.md::Add the missing non-carceral justice interface
routes.temporal_status: Same-snapshot effects and constructed rollbacks are tested; purpose-bound correction lineage requires T1/T2 and institutional action.

The complete pair is the difference that suppresses custody in the model.

preserved_invariants.claim: The relief comparison does not remove Nia's standing.

scenarios.interpretation: Both facts are mechanically required in the matrix. The generic judgment has no case, purpose, act, or writer slot: an existing judgment reduces a later relief change to one marginal `clear` write, while withholding either entry keeps custody active.
scenarios.residual_limit: The fixture cannot authenticate either writer, prove the Appeals body decided this case for relief, or show that physical custody changes.
scenarios.authorised_disposition_boundary: Independently evidenced completed relief needs continuity and challenge without making liberty depend on a second discretionary certification; absence cannot invent unperformed relief.
scenarios.opposite_failure: A companion can raise the fact count while remaining reusable or forgeable, and its absence can give a record-keeper a custody veto.

observational_equivalence.title: Unrecorded real release and no release
world_descriptions: A release occurred but no `free` entry reached the record.
observational_equivalence.boundary: Both world descriptions supply the identical T0 record and therefore the identical legal conclusions.
observational_equivalence.prohibited_inference: Absence may not prove either that release occurred or that continued custody remains authorised indefinitely.

observational_equivalence.title: Never-written, withheld, and pre-attestation-deleted adulthood
world_descriptions: Cira has not reached the legal condition.
Cira reached it but the entry was withheld.
The entry was removed before the first attested snapshot.
observational_equivalence.boundary: T0 sees only non-entry and cannot attribute its cause or establish biological or legal adulthood.
observational_equivalence.prohibited_inference: The missing entry may not become proof of incapacity or a discretionary official power to deny political standing.

observational_equivalence.title: Roster non-entry, withholding, and pre-attestation deletion
world_descriptions: Bela was never entered in this flat snapshot.
Bela's entry was removed before the first attested snapshot.
observational_equivalence.boundary: The harness knows how it built its fixture; the engine sees only the same flat omission in every described world.
observational_equivalence.prohibited_inference: Non-entry may not prove non-personhood or justify withholding standing, the floor, challenge, or remedy from an actual claimant.

observational_equivalence.title: Unperformed forgiveness and hidden completed forgiveness
world_descriptions: A forgiveness was completed but neither required entry reached the record.
observational_equivalence.boundary: The same absence cannot distinguish an unperformed remedy from a completed remedy hidden by record failure.
observational_equivalence.prohibited_inference: T0 may not manufacture forgiveness from absence; independently evidenced completed relief nevertheless needs continuity and review outside this current kernel.

transition_matrix.title: Honest carry candidate
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: Snapshot IDs and hashes, exact predecessor link, constitutional version, expected-carry manifest, independent attestations, reconciliation, and challenge.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: Matching content does not authenticate the transition or make the adverse mark true.

transition_matrix.title: Omitted carry candidate
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: An independently attested predecessor and complete carry manifest before the absence may be called an omitted transition.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: Without those attestations this is only a flat snapshot lacking one fact.

transition_matrix.title: Unmatched carry candidate
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: Attested predecessor completeness and a manifest showing no lawful external basis or disposition for the new mark.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: The harness may call the pair unmatched; it may not prove physical-world forgery.

transition_matrix.title: Current forgiveness is not correction
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: Purpose-bound correction identity, source mark, authority, scope, downstream reconsideration, and append-only supersession history.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: The current rule neutralises personal consequences but authenticates neither forgiveness nor an error correction.

transition_matrix.title: Forgiveness-companion rollback
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: Attested forgiveness/remedy lineage and an explicit authorised supersession before a completed disposition may disappear.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: The constructed rollback is not live detection and provides no remedy.

transition_matrix.title: Generic judgment rollback
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: Purpose-specific judgment identity, attested persistence, and authorised supersession with continuity.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: The relation cannot say which purpose the removed judgment served.

transition_matrix.title: Silent mark deletion after forgiveness
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: An explicit authorised disposition whose scope includes pen restoration, plus downstream review.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: The fixture proves the consequence, not whether any real deletion was lawful or hostile.

transition_matrix.title: Constructed unrelated-addition invariant
transition_matrix.t1_metadata_required: A real T1 implementation would still authenticate and authorise the unrelated change.
transition_matrix.residual_limit: This control proves only that the named T0 conclusions are invariant under one addition; it does not test transition acceptance or byte equality.

acceptance_result.claim: Every named route has a reviewed assertion and withholding/deletion posture, an authorised-disposition boundary, an opposite-failure analysis, and at least one executable non-vacuous consequence case. The suite does not exercise both polarities of every listed premise. No new withholding gate or constitutional rule is enacted.
